verdict.rationale: Kong documents a RESTful Admin API (port 8001) that configures routing, load balancing, health checks and other entities. Kong also publishes a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its APIs and lists the Konnect REST APIs as a supported programmatic surface. The official go-kong bindings, Terraform providers and decK build on these APIs and are maintained with integration tests. The OpenAPI probe 404s only hit guessed paths and do not contradict the documented spec directory. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use, and a supported general-purpose Konnect client SDK (the Go SDK is labeled a prototype).
